Update a boss Object After Adding New Essential Fill-in Design Points

update_boss.Rd

Given a boss object that already has an essential_design_points list, this function does the following:

  1. Fills in any missing NA responses by evaluating the objective function.

  2. Recomputes the mode and its Hessian based on the updated design.

  3. Re-fits the GP hyperparameters (length-scale and signal variance) using MLE.

  4. Constructs and stores an efficient surrogate closure for fast prediction, using precomputed posterior weights (and GLS mean model if quad=TRUE).

Usage

update_boss(boss_result)

Arguments

boss_result

A boss object with fields:

essential_design_points

List with x_original, y, x.

lower, upper

Bounds for scaling inputs.

objective_function

Callable to evaluate new design points.

gp_params

Includes noise_var, nu, quad flag, etc.

Value

The updated boss_result, with:

essential_design_points$y

Updated with evaluated values.

mode, mode_hessian

Recomputed for the surrogate.

gp_params

Updated hyperparameters.

surrogate

A closure for predicting at new inputs.
